_comment: Labelled retrieval set. 'type' marks what each query stresses: paraphrase queries carry no shared vocabulary with the source and should favour dense retrieval; exact queries hinge on a literal token (an error code, a version string) and should favour BM25. A gold set made only of one type measures half a pipeline and makes hybrid retrieval look pointless.
